breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflict between the periodic domain specification and the simultaneous listing of both periodic and Dirichlet boundary conditions. The agent resolved this by correctly omitting the contradictory Dirichlet condition ('u = 0') and only including the periodic condition, which is consistent with the ground truth.
